[[Lady/Legends|Lady]] '''Winella Munkus''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Artisan/Legends|artisan]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TempArtisan.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Lady Winella Munkus, including five non-Human depictions deemed non-canon in ''Legends'']]
Winella Munkus was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Because Winella Munkus spawned under the generic "artisan" template, her appearance was randomized under one of six possible depictions. She could appear as a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]], [[Bith/Legends|Bith]], [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]], [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], or [[Kajain'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kajain'sa'Nikto]] of the male gender, or as a Human female. Because the [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] dialogue identified Munkus as female, this article assumes that the Human female depiction is [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="AED" />
